senses.gloss: ch. same, esp. (corresp. to h. בּוֹא) to enter a town, a house &c.; to come in (interch. with עוּל).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:2">Targ. Prov. XI, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:4:7">Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מי ע׳</he> when he was going home. Ib.ᶜ top <he>כד דאנא עָלֵיל וכ׳</he> when I was coming home from the hill.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>כד דאתית למֵיעוֹל</he> when thou wert about to go home.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:9:9">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בר קפרא אִיעֲלַל … מי ע׳ וכ׳</he> B. K. was trying to enter a town; when he entered it &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:1:4">Y. Erub. V, beg. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>תלת … עבר עָלֵיל קומי וכ׳</he> thirteen years he spent going in and out before his teacher without need (of his instruction).
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:3:1">Koh. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>עָלְלִין ונפקין</he> are brought in and taken out again; a. e.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 15:12">Targ. O. Gen. XV, 12</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be busy, have to do with, (euphem.) to sport.
units: Esth. R. to II, 16 אנא יהיב … ועליל עמה I would give one hundred denars to sport with her; Yalk. Gen. 67; (Gen. R. s. 40 ואִיעֲלַל Ithpa.).

<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 19:10">Targ. O. Lev. XIX, 10</cite> (ed. Berl. <he>תְעַלִיל</he>; ed. Amst. <he>תְעָליל</he>); <cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:21">Deut. XXIV, 21</cite> <he>תְעַלֵּיל</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Amst. a. Y. <he>תְעָלֵיל</he>).

senses.gloss: (fr. עוּל), אָעוֹל, אֵ׳ to cause to go in; to carry in, bring in.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 6:19">Targ. Gen. VI, 19</cite> (Y. ed. Vien. <he>תֵעוֹל</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 66:11">Targ. Ps. LXVI, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 47:24">Targ. O. Gen. XLVII, 24</cite> <he>אָעוֹלֵי</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <he>אַעוּלֵי</he>, verbal noun).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Haggai 1:9">Targ. Hag. I, 9</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 10:19">Targ. Job X, 19</cite> <he>אֶתְּעָל</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 21:32">Ib. XXI, 32</cite> <he>יִתָּעֵל</he> ed. Wil. (oth. ed. <he>יִתְּעָל</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 43:18">Targ. O. Gen. XLIII, 18</cite> (Y. <he>מִתְעֲל׳</he>, ed. Vien. <he>מִתְעָ׳</he>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to attempt entrance. Y. Sabb. l. c., v. supra.—3) to busy one’s self, to sport. Gen. R. l. c., v. supra.
